page.title: Settings
page.description: Rotation scheduling, failure notifications, log privacy, system updates, appearance, and the admin password.

weakPassword.message: The admin account is still using the initial weak password. Change it now.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Display theme of the admin console; the topbar button cycles through themes.

errors.maxAttempts: Must be an integer between 1 and 10
errors.cooldownSeconds: Must be an integer of at least 1
errors.failureThreshold: Must be an integer between 3 and 20
errors.logRetentionDays: Must be an integer between 0 and 365 (0 = keep forever)
errors.bounceThreshold: Must be a number between 0 and 100 (0 = alerts off)

toast.secretRotated: Signing secret rotated; receivers must update their verification key
toast.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the text and copy it manually
toast.purgeDaysInvalid: Days must be an integer between 1 and 3650
toast.passwordChanged: Password changed; the current session stays signed in and all other sessions of this account have been signed out

rotation.title: Rotation & Retry
rotation.description: Channel scheduling and failure handling for /v1/send.
rotation.strategyHint: Priority: channels ordered by priority ascending, least-recently-used first within a level; Round robin: always least-recently-used first
rotation.cooldownHint: Cooldown duration after platform rate limiting (seconds, ≥1)
rotation.failureThresholdHint: Auto-disable a channel after this many consecutive failures (3-20)

notify.title: Failure Notifications
notify.description: Get alerted via in-app notifications or webhook when sends fail or channels misbehave.
notify.inappDesc: Failure events go to the topbar notification bell
notify.webhookDesc: Push JSON notifications to a custom URL
notify.urlRequired: A URL is required when webhook notifications are enabled
notify.urlPattern: URL must start with http:// or https://
notify.noEvents: Select at least one event (or simply turn the switches off)
notify.secretDesc: When configured, every notification carries an X-CatMail-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256, ±5-minute timestamp tolerance); deliveries are unsigned otherwise. Update the receiver's verification key after rotation.
notify.rotateConfirm: Rotate the signing secret? Receivers must update their verification key after rotation.
notify.testUsesSaved: The test uses the saved settings

logPrivacy.title: Log Privacy
logPrivacy.description: Control whether send logs store email body snapshots.
logPrivacy.logBodyDesc: When on, logs keep HTML/plain-text body previews; turning it off only affects new logs, already recorded bodies are untouched
logPrivacy.bodyNoteOn: Email bodies are only previewed by admins in log details for troubleshooting and never leave the system except with log exports
logPrivacy.bodyNoteOff: When off, new logs will not include body previews and the detail panel cannot show body content (logs missing bodies can no longer be resent in one click later)

delivery.title: Delivery & Suppression
delivery.description: Auto-suppression for bounces/complaints and channel bounce-rate alerts.
delivery.autoSuppressDesc: Automatically block the recipient on hard bounce / complaint events (can be lifted on the Suppression List page)
delivery.thresholdDesc: When a channel's 7-day bounce rate exceeds the threshold, alerts broadcast via both notification channels (toggle the event in the whitelist above); 0 = off

data.title: Data Management
data.description: Full SQLite backups and send-log purging; to restore, stop the server, replace data/catmail.db with the backup file, then start again.
data.dailyBackupDesc: When on, one backup is taken per day (last 10 kept); a catch-up backup runs on restart day
data.emptyDescription: Click "Back Up Now" to create the first full backup

purge.title: Log Purge
purge.description: Manually delete send logs; deletion is irreversible, proceed with care
purge.descBeforeDays_one: Send logs older than {{count}} day will be permanently deleted (including bodies and error details).
purge.descBeforeDays_other: Send logs older than {{count}} days will be permanently deleted (including bodies and error details).
purge.descChannel: All send logs of channel "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted.
purge.descAll: All send logs will be cleared (the schema is kept; dashboard and log page history will disappear as well).
purge.suggestBackup: Consider running "Back Up Now" first to snapshot the current data.

update.title: System Update
update.description: Check and install new versions from GitHub Releases (enabled by CATMAIL_UPDATE_REPO); SHA-256 verification is enforced before updating.
update.dockerHint: For container deployments, upgrade by pulling a new image (docker pull, then recreate the container); file-based self-update is not supported

password.title: Change Password
password.description: After a successful change, the current session stays signed in and all other sessions of this account will be signed out.
password.tooShort: New password must be at least 6 characters
password.tooLong: Password must be at most 72 characters
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match

totp.title: Two-Step Verification
totp.descEnabled: Signing in requires an authenticator code or a recovery code in addition to the password.
totp.descDisabled: When enabled, signing in additionally requires an authenticator code, adding another line of defense to the account.
totp.hintEnabled: To switch authenticators, unbind first and start over.
totp.hintDisabled: Works with any TOTP authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, etc.).
totp.qrFailed: QR code generation failed; add it manually with the secret below
totp.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator
totp.scanHint: Scan with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, 1Password); if scanning fails, enter the secret below manually
totp.codeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code currently shown in your authenticator
totp.saveFirstWarning: Please confirm the recovery codes are saved first
totp.recoveryWarning: Recovery codes are shown only this once and cannot be viewed again. Use them to sign in if you lose your phone (each works once).
totp.savedConfirm: I have stored the recovery codes somewhere safe (password manager, printout, etc.)
totp.recoveryCopied: Recovery codes copied to the clipboard
totp.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the codes and copy them manually
totp.disableHint: After disabling, signing in only needs the password. Enter the current password to confirm:

sessions.title: Active Sessions
sessions.description: Devices that recently signed in to this account; signing out a session invalidates its login immediately (API Keys are not affected).
sessions.revokeNote: The device's login state will be invalidated immediately and it must sign in again; API Keys are not affected.
sessions.revokeOthersBodySuffix_one: active session other than the current one; the current session stays signed in.
sessions.revokeOthersBodySuffix_other: active sessions other than the current one; the current session stays signed in.
sessions.emptyDescription: After signing in, all active sessions of this account are listed here.
